protocol.question: Does a trust region on the full cap-plus-projection correction prevent combined-gradient amplification while preserving the accuracy gains across three seeds?
protocol.budget: Per arm: the same 1024 distinct rows, one exposure each, 128 updates and three task-separated forward/backward computations per update

methods_detail.raw: Mean gradient per task, weighted 3/8 PAWS + 3/8 SNLI + 2/8 replay, then global norm clip at 1; seeds42/43 reused, seed44 newly trained
methods_detail.soft_cap_2x_then_project: Apply the two-times-median cap, deterministic symmetric projection to negative-gradient pairs, row-share weighting and global clip; seeds42/43 reused, seed44 newly trained
methods_detail.soft_cap_2x_project_trust: Treat cap plus projection as a correction to raw task-gradient aggregation; take the largest interpolation coefficient in [0,1] whose combined norm does not exceed the current raw combined norm, then global clip

protocol.projection_note: Both treatments use the same PCGrad-inspired deterministic symmetric transform; the candidate adds a direction-changing trust region on the full correction, not a cosmetically equivalent scalar before global clipping, and is not an implementation-equivalence claim for randomized PCGrad
matched: same common starting adapter and head weights
same exact rows, row blocks, stateless candidate permutations and task forward order within seed
same task-separated forward/backward count for all methods
same clean CE + 0.5 Brier risk and 3/8, 3/8, 2/8 task weights
same AdamW settings, learning rates, global clipping threshold and 128 updates
primary_endpoints: maximum and p95 combined pre-clip gradient norm
per-task raw gradient norm tails and global clipping rate
diagnostic_endpoints: old-task replay sources in the fixed test set
previously inspected BoolQ and WinoGrande accuracy and candidate prediction counts
protocol.success_rule: The trust candidate advances to a fresh task blind evaluation only if no PAWS or SNLI accuracy is more than 1.0 point below raw in any of three seeds, its mean accuracy change across all six comparisons is nonnegative, combined-gradient p95 does not exceed raw in any seed, at seeds42/43 it does not exceed the unbounded composition p95, the trust bound is never violated, and the trust region changes direction on at least 10 percent of updates in every seed; old diagnostics cannot rescue a primary-endpoint failure
protocol.checkpoint_selection: All nine endpoints are fixed before new training; four controls are reused bit-for-bit, five endpoints are newly trained, with no early stopping or endpoint-based method selection
limitations: Three seeds still do not estimate the full population distribution
BoolQ and WinoGrande are previously inspected diagnostics, not fresh blind tests
Four seed42/43 controls are reused rather than retrained; validators require identical plans and first-step raw task statistics for each method within seed
Public-base pretraining contamination cannot be excluded
